summary: Greenpro Capital Corp. filed an 8-K reporting completion on September 28, 2026 of its disposition of six Hong Kong, Belize and Shenzhen entities (the F&A Entities) to Ms. Chen Yanhong, a director of several subsidiaries and holder of 14 common shares. Aggregate cash consideration was HK$3,500,000 (about US$446,486 at August 31, 2026 rates). All intercompany balances were waived at closing, producing an estimated $5,303,075 reduction in additional paid-in capital; the units will be reported as discontinued operations from Q3 2026. Proceeds fund general corporate purposes. The related-party angle and minimal headline value are the watch items.
